clauses.text: After a denial with reason code 252, the documentation named in the remittance remark must be received within 30 days of the denial date.
Documentation must be dated, must identify its author and must have been written at the time of the service. A later addendum must be labelled as such and may clarify, but not add, clinical findings.

A positive airway pressure device (E0601) requires a sleep study report with an apnea-hypopnea index (AHI) of 15 or more events per hour; or an AHI from 5 to 14 with at least one of the following documented: excessive daytime sleepiness, impaired cognition, mood disorder, insomnia, hypertension, ischaemic heart disease or a history of stroke.

Hyaluronan injection of the knee (J7325) requires radiographic evidence of knee osteoarthritis, and at least 6 months of conservative treatment that included both analgesic medication and supervised physical therapy, without adequate relief.

clauses.section_heading: When the documentation does not exist
clauses.text: If the required documentation was never created, the requirement is not met and the denial stands. A statement written from memory after the denial does not meet the requirement.
